lines.en: Sssss, crawl forward.
Shadows sway, closing in.
Sssss, fade into shadows.

lines.zh: 阴影紧随其后，发出低语。
lines.en: Whispers follow the shadows.
Lunge at player, sssss.

lines.zh: 阴影扭曲，形成狰狞脸庞。
lines.en: Shadows twist, forming a grim face.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶尖叫，试图吞噬玩家。
lines.en: Scream sssss, trying to devour.
Shadows tremble, solidifying.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶低语，似在耳边呢喃。
lines.en: Sssss, whispers near.
Approach player, sssss.

lines.zh: 影子贴着墙根滑行，无声。
lines.en: The shadow slides along the wall, soundless.

lines.zh: 从蒲公英的影子里爬出来。
lines.en: It crawls out of the dandelion's shadow.
Sharp teeth appear in shadows.

lines.zh: 低声呢喃，形如蠕动之蛇。
lines.en: Whispering, forms like writhing snakes.
Green eyes glow in shadows.

lines.zh: 发出嘶嘶声，形体摇曳不定。
lines.en: Sssss, form wavers.

lines.zh: 低语，阴影中手伸向玩家。
lines.en: Whisper, hands reach out in shadows.

lines.zh: 阴影中扭曲出狰狞面孔。
lines.en: Grim faces appear in shadows.

lines.zh: 低声呢喃，形如蜷缩之蛇。
lines.en: Whispering, forms like coiled snakes.

lines.zh: 阴影中眼睛一亮，露出獠牙。
lines.en: Eyes glow, fangs appear.

lines.zh: 阴影低语，形如蠕动之虫。
lines.en: Whispering, forms like writhing insects.

lines.zh: 阴影中蠕动着模糊的手。
lines.en: Hands wriggle in shadows.
You forgot to swallow that pill.

lines.zh: 角落的蒲公英又暗了一分。
lines.en: The dandelion in the corner dims another shade.

lines.zh: 低头看自己的手，看不见。
lines.en: It looks down at its hands and sees nothing.
It counts your heartbeats, slowly.
Stare at player, sssss.
Gaze at player, green eyes glow.
Stare at player, sssss.
Stare at player, form twists.
Stare at player, sssss scream.
Whisper, stare at player.

lines.zh: 盯紧玩家，形如蠕动之蛇。
lines.en: Stare at player, forms like writhing snakes.
Gaze at player, form twists.
Stare at player, green eyes glow.

lines.zh: 它歪头，像在认一张旧照片。
lines.en: It tilts its head, recognizing an old photograph.

lines.zh: 它盯着你眼下的黑眼圈。
lines.en: It stares at the shadows under your eyes.

lines.zh: 别移开视线，它喜欢这样。
lines.en: Don't look away. It likes that.
It searches for itself in your pupils.
It counts every blink you make.
It blinks with you, half a beat late.

lines.zh: 它把脸凑到离你一格处。
lines.en: It brings its face one block from yours.

lines.zh: 它看你，像看裂开的镜子。
lines.en: It looks at you like a cracked mirror.

lines.zh: 它记住了你此刻的样子。
lines.en: It memorizes how you look right now.
It is waiting for you to blink first.
Its stare chills the back of your neck.
Sssss, your end is here!
Run, I'm here!

lines.zh: 我的形状被击散，又聚回来。
lines.en: My shape scatters, then gathers again.

lines.zh: 幻象被砍开，边缘冒着凉气。
lines.en: The illusion splits, cold air seeping from its edge.
I'll always follow you!
The more lucid you are, the firmer I stand.
You can't escape my shadow!
Don't look back, looking back means death!
I'll never give up!
You're destined to be devoured!
Consumed by darkness?
Taste my shadow.
Don't betray your kind.
Your sanity's almost gone.
Follow me into nothingness.

lines.zh: 你的药瓶滚到了我脚边。
lines.en: Your pill bottle rolls to my feet.

lines.zh: 蒲公英的最后一瓣，落向你了。
lines.en: The dandelion's last petal falls toward you.
Join me, sink together.
Your sanity fades.
Fall, into darkness.

lines.zh: 你挡在走廊中间，我穿过去。
lines.en: You stand in the hallway; I pass through.
Don't move.

lines.zh: 影子多了一个，你数过吗？
lines.en: One extra shadow. Did you count?
Let me through.

lines.zh: 你的手穿过我，只抓到冷气。
lines.en: Your hand passes through me, catching only cold.

lines.zh: 你的理智一低，我就成形了。
lines.en: When your sanity drops, I take shape.
Move aside.

lines.zh: 我贴着你肩头挤过去，很凉。
lines.en: I squeeze past your shoulder, cold.
Don't block me.
Let me pass through. Just once.
It's hard to find you.
My mate.
Let's be together.
You're one of us.

lines.zh: 你的理智，分我一半就好。
lines.en: Just give me half of your sanity.
I will live in your reflection.
You're my ideal mate.

lines.zh: 你闭上眼睛，我们就重合了。
lines.en: Close your eyes and we overlap.
You match me.
Together, in the dark.
This is your end!

lines.zh: 我把你掉的东西捏成灰。
lines.en: I crumble what you dropped into ash.
This is the end.
Your soul is mine now.
Darkness is everything.
Your sanity is gone.
You will be eternally trapped.
Your fate is revealed here.
Fear will consume you.
Now, you are my prey.

lines.zh: 你踩到的每块砖，我都记得。
lines.en: I remember every brick you step on.

lines.zh: 你视线的余光把我拼完整了。
lines.en: The corner of your vision completes me.
The more you fear me, the clearer I get.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸声泄露了位置。
lines.en: Your breathing gives you away.
Beware, there's danger behind you.
You moved, you were spotted.

lines.zh: 你的一举一动都在我掌控中。
lines.en: Every move you make is in my control.

lines.zh: 你的声音暴露了你的位置。
lines.en: Your voice gave you away.

lines.zh: 追踪你就像在玩捉迷藏。
lines.en: Chasing you is like a game of hide and seek.
Your presence is too strong.
The light dies, and now you see me clearly.
You stepped on your own shadow.
That pill bottle is empty now.
You turn, and it has moved.
Your dandelion is trembling.
You heard your name being spoken.

lines.zh: 你回头看见的每个影子都像我。
lines.en: Every shadow you turn to looks like me.

lines.zh: 我的数目又多了，你数不清。
lines.en: There are more of me now than you can count.

lines.zh: 这栋楼的墙缝里都是我。
lines.en: I fill every crack in these walls.

lines.zh: 我站在墙角，只有你知道我在。
lines.en: I stand in the corner; only you know I'm here.
You will be torn apart.
You can't escape my grasp.
The time to hunt you has come.
I'll make you fear.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的间隙，我就近一尺。
lines.en: Between your blinks, I close a foot of distance.
Your fate is about to end.
I will follow you out of these woods.
Wherever you run, walls cast shadows.
Each light dies and I step closer.
I get inside before the door shuts.
Count to three and I arrive.
The night is long enough for me to stay.
Run, and I learn your stride.
Don't turn around, or I'll be face to face.
I wait at the end of your shadow.
I will be where you gasp for air.

lines.zh: 我伸手，指甲刮过你的耳廓。
lines.en: I reach out; my nail scrapes your ear.
Feel the chill of the shadows!
You can't escape, I'm here!
Darkness is my companion!
Feed me with your soul!
You can't escape my shadow!
Night's terrifying presence!
Predator of the shadows!
Feel my claws!
Roar of the shadows!
A fistful of your sanity, taken.
This cut opens an old wound.
A hand from behind you, very gently.
No pill will save you from this.
I leave your scream inside the wall.
You should have felt this claw long ago.

lines.zh: 你的理智越薄，我越清楚。
lines.en: The thinner your sanity, the clearer I get.
Rationality down, I appear!
The more you fear, the more of me there are.
Your dreams will be devoured!
More and more illusions!
Entity of shadow fear!
Sanity about to collapse!
Wanderer of the night!
Watcher of the shadows!
Enemy of the shadows!
The dandelion dims, and I am here.
Did you hear the hinge creak?
Your sanity will not last tonight.
I borrow the shape of your shadow.

lines.zh: 屋里多了一个人的重量。
lines.en: The room holds one more person's weight.
The lamp still burns, and I come anyway.
You left the pill bottle on the nightstand.
This is the third sleepless night.
I start at the corner of your eye.
Don't open that door. I am outside.
The fire only makes me darker.

lines.zh: 我只是幻象，连坠落都是假的。
lines.en: I'm only a vision — even the fall is fake.
I breathe fine underwater.
I'm not even a shadow.
The arrow passes through and hits only shadow.
The spell washed my illusion white.
I eat no food. I eat the night.

lines.zh: 雷光里，我的轮廓被照白。
lines.en: In the lightning, my outline turns white.
In the void, I am simply home.
